devices.title: Devices
devices.empty_description: Open LanShare on another computer on the same network.
devices.drop_hint: Drop files on a device to send them.

transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.empty_description: Files you send or receive appear here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.choose_folder_title: Choose where to save received files
settings.streams_hint: 1 to 16. More can help on fast networks.
settings.chunk_size_hint: 1 to 64. Larger can be faster; smaller resends less after a dropped connection.
settings.allow_untrusted: Allow devices that are not paired
settings.allow_untrusted_hint: They can offer files, and you still decide. Traffic is encrypted either way.
settings.close_to_tray: Keep receiving in the tray when the window is closed
settings.start_at_login: Start LanShare when I log in
settings.restart_note: Changing the name, port or download folder restarts receiving and stops running transfers.
settings.export_diagnostics_hint: Saves logs and settings to a zip file you can share when reporting a problem. Your device key and paired devices are never included.

offer.title: Incoming file
offer.from: {device} wants to send you a file.
offer.not_paired: This device is not paired. Only accept files you expect.

text.label: Text
text.too_long: This is too long for a text. Send it as a file instead.
text.more: {count, plural, one {# more text waiting} other {# more texts waiting}}

pairing.title: Pair devices
pairing.show_pin: {device} wants to pair with this device. Type this PIN on that device:

update.title: Update available
update.body: LanShare {version} is ready to install. You have version {current}.
update.failed: The update could not be installed. Try again later.

notifications.pairing_body: {device} wants to pair. Open LanShare to see the PIN.
notifications.text_body: {device} sent you a text. Open LanShare to see it.

errors.VERSION_MISMATCH: {device} is using a different version of LanShare. Update both devices.
errors.INVALID_FILE_NAME: The file name is not allowed.
errors.IO: A file or network operation failed.
errors.PROTOCOL_VIOLATION: The other device sent unexpected data.
errors.CONNECTION_LOST: The connection was lost. Send again to continue where it stopped.
errors.PEER_UNREACHABLE: Couldn't reach {device}. Make sure both devices are on the same network and LanShare is open.
errors.HASH_MISMATCH: The received data was damaged. Send again to retry.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_SPACE: Not enough space. Need {needed}, only {available} free.
errors.TRANSPORT_UNAVAILABLE: The connection was blocked. Check your firewall settings.
errors.UNTRUSTED_DEVICE: The devices are not paired. Pair them first.
errors.FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH: This device is not the one you paired with. Remove it and pair again if you trust it.
errors.PAIRING_FAILED: Pairing failed. Check the PIN and try again.
errors.PAIRING_LOCKED: Too many wrong PINs. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
errors.BUSY: {device} is busy. Try again in a moment.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: Can't save to {folder}. Choose another download folder in Settings.
errors.TEXT_TOO_LONG: This text is too long. At most {maxBytes} can be sent as text; send it as a file instead.
errors.macos_local_network: On macOS, also check that LanShare is allowed under System Settings → Privacy & Security → Local Network.
